label: Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1, HAS_WILL_1 and causes the being of all directs all else to an end
paraphrase: Open bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed. Whatever has intellect (HAS_INTELLECT_1), has will (HAS_WILL_1) and causes the being of every other being in act as to being (IsCreatorOfAll) directs each other being in act as to being to some end (Directs g x e, the quinta via / q.103 relation). The three are separate conjuncts: the antecedent does not say that the being causes THROUGH its intellect and will (definition 92c03350 leaves freedom of the act unencoded). After ST I q.22 a.2: every agent acts for an end, and the ordering of effects to that end extends as far as the causality of the first agent extends. That reason presupposes intellectual, voluntary agency (cf. q.19 a.4, God causes by will, not by necessity of nature), so the bridge also carries an unstated step: a being with intellect and will that causes the being of all does so through them. The relevant alternative is necessary emanation by an intellect (a first intellect from which everything else proceeds by necessity of its nature, not by choice); no independent justification for it is on file, and it is recorded as a named alternative, not as an objection. Restricted to a cause of the being of ALL others. The side effects on file (effects outside an intelligent agent's intention) all involve a particular cause, and their mechanism, according to q.22 a.2 ad 1 (attributed, unpinned), is the concurrence of other causes not ordered by that cause; that mechanism is absent when one cause gives being to everything else. This is a reason from the cited reply, not a logical consequence of the antecedent. It does not say how the direction is carried out (immediately or through intermediaries, q.103 a.6), what the being knows of each thing (it says nothing about the mode of cognition), nor that the end is the same for all. Control part 4: without it, a being with the nine directs and governs nothing and is not LORD_2.
